Solenis is a leading global producer of specialty chemicals focused on partnering with water\-intensive operations to solve complex water treatment, process improvement and hygiene challenges with advanced chemical and equipment solutions for consumer, industrial, institutional, food \& beverage, and recreational pool and spa water markets.


The product portfolio of Solenis includes a broad array of water treatment chemistries, process aids, functional additives, and cleaners and disinfectants, as well as state\-of\-the\-art monitoring and control systems. **KNOWLEDGE/EXPERIENCE/PERSON** **PROFILE**

* Demonstrated Healthcare Sales Management experience.
* Demonstrated proven ability to build and nurture customer relationships

* Excellent time management skills

description:
**Description**
 This is a unique opportunity to help shape the workplace experience for Amazonians around the world. The Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) organization is responsible for creating the spaces that inspire Amazonians to make history. The globally diverse team manages Amazon’s corporate offices in more than 60 countries. GREF provides real estate transactions expertise, business partnering, space and occupancy planning, design and construction, capital investment program management, facility maintenance, and operations all contributing to the employee experience and leveraging places and programs to enable culture to thrive at Amazon.
   

  

 Within GREF, the Global Customer Insights team represents the voice of the Amazonian throughout the workplace journey. We surface insights that help GREF deliver a workplace experience that enables Amazonians to do their best work while at the office.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced user research operations professional to join our Global Customer Insights team. As a Sr. Research Operations specialist in GREF, you will drive operational excellence across our global research initiatives. This role will be instrumental in scaling our research capabilities, managing participant recruitment for APAC and EMEA regions, and building an engaged research community that enables rapid customer feedback.
   

  

 If you are passionate about growing a research operations function and collaborating with researchers, strategists, and fellow research operations professionals to deliver research with excellence, we want you on our team.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end participant recruitment and logistics support for APAC and EMEA\-based research projects
* Conduct detailed Level of Effort (LoE) assessments to evaluate recruitment complexity, timeline requirements for incoming APAC and EMEA\-based project requests
* Ensure consistent, professional participant communication that represents both GREF and Customer Insights with one unified voice
* Maintain compliance with global and regional privacy guidelines, PII regulations, and data retention policies across all recruitment activities
* Own and manage our User Research Panel, serving as the primary point of contact for rapid usability studies and stakeholder self\-serve operations
* Collaborate with researchers to optimize recruitment timelines and reduce lead times for rapid usability studies
* Evolve the User Research panel from a recruitment database into an engaged online community that enables two\-way feedback and ongoing dialogue
* Maintain visibility into participant engagement rates to prevent over\-surveying, reduce fatigue, and eliminate duplicative research efforts
* Support the Self\-Serve Customer Feedback Toolkit for certified stakeholders, establishing governance frameworks and requirements to ensure quality standards while enabling stakeholder self\-service moments.
* Lead ongoing vendor relationships for project and panel management platforms, and research tools
* Evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance research operations capabilities
* Ensure we have the right tools in our toolbox to enable efficient, high\-quality research across diverse methodologies


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Sociology, Anthropology, Human Computer Interaction, or a related field
* 5\+ years of recruiting or research work at a market insights firm, executive search firm, or global in\-house executive search team experience
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi\-regional recruitment efforts across different time zones and cultural contexts
* Strong understanding of privacy regulations, data protection requirements, and legal compliance considerations for research operations
* Experience with research panel management and participant database systems
* Proven vendor management skills with ability to negotiate contracts and manage external partnerships
* Excellent project management skills with ability to balance multiple priorities and stakeholders


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with teams across APAC region
* Experience handling multiple projects in parallel
* Background in building or scaling research panels or online communities
* Familiarity with research tools such as Dscout, UserTesting, or similar platforms
* Experience developing self\-serve processes or toolkits that democratize research capabilities
* Experience in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments requiring rapid iteration and process optimization

description:
**Description**
 Inventory Trust team (SPIV) works to ensure that bad actors cannot profit from using our services to abuse Customers, Selling Partners or our Store. Our mission is to safeguard our store from bad inventory and bad actors concealing their identities. To accomplish this mission, we withhold funds from bad actors, deny our fulfillment network to bad actors as a means to scale their abuse and ensure that counterfeit/illegal inventory is destroyed, prevent Seller credit abuse, identify and disrupt bad actor “spare accounts”, and generate insights to help SPS understand where bad actors are prioritizing their efforts.
   

  

 If we successfully achieve our vision, then Bad Actors will stop committing misconduct on Amazon. While we obsess over customers, we specialize in obsessing over bad actors to identify their friction points and multiply them exponentially in ways that don’t impact good sellers. Our vision is to ensure Bad Actors never receive a dollar from selling on Amazon and abusing our policies. This is done with minimal friction for good sellers, clearly communicated policies, and accurate calculations.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Risk Manager II to own complex projects, take high judgement decisions and manage escalations associated with our program’s expansion. In addition to making the right decisions, the candidate will need to be able to use SQL knowledge and use data as evidence to convince/influence key stakeholders.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Innovating and designing new or improved processes to support the business needs.

* Maintain a strong understanding of best in class risk and control principles, and regulatory expectations – embed governance processes to perform recurring gap analysis against those expectations, and drive remediation where necessary.
* Identify and develop appropriate data sources and elements which contribute to risk\-based assessments.
* Experience working in or supporting a fast\-paced operations environment.
* Perform operational deep dives on compliance\-related processes and systems. Understand business processes, regulations and controls, work with partners to identify root cause of issues.
* Take leading role in drafting and presenting deep\-dive documents, including responses to senior executives and Correction of Errors (COE) reports.
* Analyze existing policy and process gaps, and develop solutions to close them.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 5\+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 3\+ years of L5 Manager Role experience


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience

* Experience with operations, risk, fraud investigations etc.
* Experience using data and metrics to back up assumptions and implement effective solutions

description:
**Description**
 Retail Business Services (RBS) supports Amazon’s Retail business growth WW through three core tasks. These are (a) Selection, where RBS sources, creates and enrich ASINs to drive GMS growth; (b) Defect Elimination: where RBS resolves inbound supply chain defects and develops root cause fixes to improve free cash flow and (c) supports operational process for WW Retail teams.
   

  

 Our team of high caliber software developers, applied scientists, data engineers, product managers and Business Intelligence Engineers use rigorous ML and deep learning approaches to ensure that we identify \& fix the right catalog defect to ensure the good shopping experience for our customers.
   

  

 As a BI Manager You directly manage a BI/DE team with existing systems (e.g., Redshift database, Data Lakes, Andes tables, Cradle, EMR processing) and defined strategy and deliver BI solutions for difficult problems efforts, and decisions. As the manager, you are accountable for the customer experience, project prioritization, data/solution quality, and system maintenance. You are also accountable for the experience of the employees that report to you. You set the example for our Leadership Principles. You take the time to understand the larger picture (i.e., customer needs, business opportunities, and problems to be solved) and share that knowledge. You partner with your manager, stakeholders, and customers (e.g., analysts, scientists, TPMs, etc.) to clarify your team’s mission, vision, and priorities. You help your team see how their work aligns with the organizational goals. You seek long\-term, strategic guidance from your manager.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the design, implementation, and delivery of BI and intermediate DE solutions for complex and ambiguous problems
* Take ownership of BI and data infrastructure and provide system\-wide design guidance
* Drive BI/DE engineering best practices and set standards for operational excellence
* Perform complex business analysis and provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership
* Design and implement technical solutions with appropriate analytics strategy and data set design
* Lead large projects that require work of multiple team members, dividing work effectively
* Mentor and develop other BIEs, L4 Des providing technical assessments for DE II, BIE II and BIE III promotions
* Build consensus and resolve contentious technical issues across teams
* Influence organizational BI architecture and cross\-team data strategies
* Communicate findings and strategic insights to management audiences


**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of business intelligence and analytics experience
* 5\+ years of delivering results managing a business intelligence or analytics team, including employee development and performance management experience
